# Vendored LCF schema

Source: https://github.com/EasyRPG/liblcf
Commit: `6854310c3432e553fd4ae672ce861899c80c3bd0`

CSV files copied unchanged from `generator/csv/`. `COPYING` is the upstream MIT
license. Used by `../../extract_rpg.py` to decode RPG Maker 2000/2003 structures
and name event opcodes. No upstream executable is required at runtime.
